correctness.rationale: Substitution T=x+y+z and s=k+3+r-T into (2k+1)x+(2k+2)y+(2k+3)z=(2k+1)(k+3+r)+1 yields y+2z=(2k+1)s+1. Nonnegative x,y,z force s>=0 and (2k+3)s<=2(k+3+r)-1<=4k+3<2(2k+3), hence s=0 or1. These yield precisely C=(k+2+r,1,0) and D_j=(j,2(r+1-j),k-r+j) for 0<=j<=r+1. Exactly C,D_0,D_(r+1) are boundary. Projection of homogeneous solution lattice to (x,y) is kernel modulo c=2k+3 of a surjective homomorphism, index c; determinant of boundary differences is (r+1)c, yielding lattice index r+1. Unique barycentric coefficients give denominator (r+1)/gcd(j,r+1) and D_1 has unbounded denominator. Direct small-k exhaustive nonnegative solution enumeration corroborates; the proof is universal.
